attributes.action: Include Endometriosis and Adenomyosis in the school curriculum
attributes.additional_details: If made part of the curriculum, less girls would believe their period pain is normal. They would be able to understand and get help quicker and hopefully would be less of a target for medical gaslighting to occur.
attributes.background: Include endometriosis and adenomyosis in the school curriculum so young girls and boys are aware of conditions that can affect them and those around them. With 1 in 10 suffering from these conditions it is vital that it be made a mandatory part of the education system.

rejection.details: You may wish to sign this petition which calls for a similar action: https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/762809
